verdict.rationale: The open-source Semgrep engine and CLI install locally via pipx or uv, run `semgrep scan` without an account or login, and analyze code locally without uploading it by default; a community user also praises the lack of a registration-only model. The commercial layer, however, is cloud-only: CI findings go to the hosted Semgrep AppSec Platform for triage, and a community member notes Supply Chain is not open source and may require uploading code. Missing for 10: a self-hostable AppSec Platform (dashboard, triage, API), evidence that Pro/Supply Chain/Secrets features run fully offline, and independent hands-on reports of a full self-hosted deployment.
